title: Positivity and non-positivity results for the sixth-order $Q$-curvature of conformal metrics in $\mathbb{R}^n$
summary: Given $n,m\in\mathbb{N}$ such that $n\ge2m\ge4$, letting $g$ be a conformally Euclidean metric on $\mathbb{R}^n$, we consider the question of positivity of the lower-order $Q$-curvatures $Q_g^{(2k)}$ for $k\in\left\{1,\dotsc,m-1\right\}$ when $Q_g^{(2m)}$ is assumed to be nonnegative and not identically zero. We assume moreover that the scalar curvature of the metric $g$ is nonnegative near infinity if $n=2m$ or that $Q_g^{(2m)}$ satisfies a slow decay barrier condition near infinity if $n>2m$. Positive results for this question have been obtained by Gursky and Malchiodi for $m=2$ and $k=1$…
